sources.title: OBDLink MX+ OEM-Specific Enhanced Diagnostics Support Coverage
sources.locator: vehicle coverage page 22; Mazda supported modules pages 46-47

records.notes: Official OBDLink coverage lists Mazda Mazda5 2006-2015 and Mazda5 (EURO) 2005, 2007. This confirms vehicle-year coverage but not proprietary request bytes or the presence of every module on every trim.

records.candidate_label: Powertrain Control Module enhanced scan candidate
records.notes: Official Mazda make-level list includes PCM. Read OEM DTCs and live parameters only after the module and PIDs are discovered on Anton's vehicle.

records.candidate_label: Transmission Control Module enhanced scan candidate
records.notes: Official Mazda make-level list includes TCM. High-value read-only targets include transmission temperature, shaft speeds, gear and torque-converter state; this row asserts no exact PID.
Official Mazda make-level list includes ABS. Candidate targets include OEM DTCs, individual wheel speeds and brake/traction states.
Official Mazda make-level list includes IC. Do not infer bus address or parameter scaling from the coverage document.

records.candidate_label: Electric power steering enhanced scan candidate
records.notes: Official Mazda make-level list includes EPS and PSCM. Exact naming may vary by market and configuration.

records.candidate_label: Steering Angle Sensor Module enhanced scan candidate
records.notes: Official Mazda make-level list includes SASM. No zero-point threshold or calibration behavior is enabled.

records.candidate_label: Restraint Control Module enhanced scan candidate
records.notes: Official Mazda list includes RCM, IABM and OCS. Read-only SRS discovery only; initialization and configuration remain prohibited.

records.candidate_label: Body control / Generic Electronic Module enhanced scan candidate
records.notes: Official Mazda make-level list includes BCM/GEM and GEM. Candidate for body DTCs and status data only.

records.candidate_label: Left Power Sliding Door Module enhanced scan candidate
records.notes: Official Mazda list explicitly includes LPSDM. Candidate for left sliding-door DTCs, latch/switch and motor status; active operation is prohibited.

records.candidate_label: Right Power Sliding Door Module enhanced scan candidate
records.notes: Official Mazda list explicitly includes RPSDM. Candidate for right sliding-door DTCs, latch/switch and motor status; active operation is prohibited.

records.candidate_label: Network-aware OEM PID discovery and persistence
records.notes: OBDLink documents that some PIDs require a specific enhanced network. On first connection the app scans supported enhanced PIDs for about 1-2 minutes and saves the results. Enumerate each offered network and persist positive support.

records.candidate_label: Mazda IDS with VCM II as professional read-only comparison target
records.notes: Mazda states IDS is for sixth-generation vehicles and earlier and is used with Mazda VCM II. Use IDS output as a comparison target for module inventory, OEM DTC names and live-data labels only.
